summary: The Bureau of Land Management Director felt the environmental statement needed additional discussion of the impacts of various types of ORVs on different types of terrain. The Director also believed the statement should clarify the status of all Interior lands before ORV use designations were made.
summary_quote: Bureau of Land Management - Director - felt that environmental statement should contain additional discussion of impacts of various types of ORV and their impacts on different types of terrain; also felt that statement should clarify status of all Interior lands prior to designation of ORV use;
